caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair positioned upright on a cream-colored background. The chair is brown and has four straight legs, a slightly trapezoidal seat, and a high, decorative backrest. The backrest is wider at the top, with a rounded, double-lobed shape, and there is a heart-shaped cutout in the upper center of the backrest. The seat and legs show visible wood grain and texture, with cast shadows beneath the chair indicating a light source from the upper left. The composition centers the chair without any other objects or background elements, and the artist's signature is in the lower right corner.
title: Side Chair
